derived_from: live GitHub PR/review/comment state plus accepted repository evidence; not chat memory

policy.mechanical: repository-owned deterministic check can decide the defect without semantic Reviewer judgment
policy.semantic: independent Reviewer reasoning is the intended detector; do not gate by superficial pattern
policy.mixed: a deterministic precondition/control can move left, but semantic judgment remains necessary

cases.reason: The impossible self-referential freshness rule required causal interpretation. The accepted CTX-01 repair now carries its own first-parent positive/negative controls; CTX-03 does not invent a generic prose-pattern gate.

Ready PR body omitted canonical handoff/process-mode metadata while handoff/freeze checks were red. CTX-03 moves this left with derivable metadata plus REVIEW_BLOCKED classification; this should not consume a semantic Reviewer FAIL round.
Reviewer found the causal completeness false-green. Accepted CTX-02 now owns the exact whole-surface omission control; CTX-03 consumes that checker instead of duplicating a new gate.

The semantic importance of reopen/escalation required review, while the accepted CTX-02 checker now deterministically enforces non-empty usable elements. Existing capsule validation remains the causal owner.
Generic natural-language equivalence is intentionally not automated. Accepted representative semantic oracles cover bounded known cases; arbitrary semantics remain Reviewer/source escalation.

The Reviewer identified both a non-causal control and a self-defined completeness universe. CTX-02 repaired them with real audit-path defect injection and completion-side discovery; CTX-03 preserves those controls rather than creating a second universe.

Checker-owned selectors are now an accepted CTX-02 invariant. CTX-03 quality replay independently requires selected authoritative sources to remain reachable but does not redefine CTX-02 selector authority.

Incomplete canonical predecessor/handoff metadata is a deterministic lifecycle defect. It belongs to REVIEW_BLOCKED before semantic review, covered by the existing handoff lint, the metadata generator and terminal closure oracle.

All prerequisite gates may be green while the durable Automation V2 REVIEW_READY marker is absent/wrong-SHA. CTX-03 closure keeps the candidate REVIEW_BLOCKED until the real marker exists and a post-marker live HEAD read still matches.
